_comment: Import into Pterodactyl as a single-server Grafana analytics Egg. Replace the placeholder Docker image before creating a server.
name: SPZ Grafana Analytics
author: SPZ
description: Single-container Grafana, FiveM health monitor, and optional track-map HTTP service.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
echo 'SPZ Grafana is baked into its custom Docker image; no second runtime or server install is needed.'

variables.name: Grafana admin user
variables.description: Initial Grafana administrator username.

variables.name: Grafana admin password
variables.description: Use a unique strong password. Grafana stores its own state under /home/container/data.

variables.name: Race MySQL host
variables.description: External Race MySQL host and optional port, for example race-db.example.net:3306.

variables.name: Race MySQL database
variables.description: Existing SPZ race database. Grafana uses this connection read-only.

variables.name: Race MySQL reader
variables.description: External MySQL account granted SELECT only on the race schema.

variables.name: Race MySQL reader password
variables.description: Password for the read-only Race MySQL account.

variables.name: FiveM endpoint host
variables.description: Public/server-reachable hostname or IP that exposes /dynamic.json.

variables.name: FiveM endpoint port
variables.description: FiveM HTTP endpoint port.

variables.name: Health poll interval
variables.description: Seconds between health probes (minimum 5 seconds).

variables.name: Health DB host
variables.description: External Health MySQL host. Leave blank to derive host/port from GF_DATABASE_HEALTH_HOST.

variables.name: Health DB port
variables.description: External Health MySQL TCP port. Leave blank to use the port in GF_DATABASE_HEALTH_HOST, otherwise 3306.

variables.name: Health DB name
variables.description: Pre-created external Health database/schema. The monitor creates only server_health_checks in this database.

variables.name: Health monitor writer
variables.description: External Health MySQL account for the monitor. Grant CREATE, ALTER, INSERT, and SELECT on the Health schema.

variables.name: Health monitor writer password
variables.description: Password for the Health monitor account.

variables.name: Grafana Health DB host
variables.description: Optional Grafana reader datasource host, with optional :port. Defaults to HEALTH_DB_HOST:HEALTH_DB_PORT.

variables.name: Grafana Health DB name
variables.description: Optional datasource schema; defaults to HEALTH_DB_NAME.

variables.name: Grafana Health DB reader
variables.description: Optional external Grafana account; use a separate SELECT-only account where possible. Defaults to HEALTH_DB_USER.

variables.name: Grafana Health DB reader password
variables.description: Optional password for the separate Grafana Health reader; defaults to HEALTH_DB_PASSWORD.

variables.name: Track map enabled
variables.description: Set false to run Grafana and the FiveM monitor without a secondary map allocation.

variables.name: Track map port
variables.description: Optional secondary Pterodactyl TCP allocation. Set the allocation to this exact port when the track map is enabled.

variables.name: Track map public URL
variables.description: Public HTTP(S) origin including its secondary port, such as http://node.example.net:8090. Used in the dashboard GeoJSON and explorer links; set it to your public address when the map is enabled.
